description:
The stories of the last `days` whose pieces name the query, one row a story, in our words with its lead
piece's outlet and link, our story page, how many pieces it was found in, its outlets and days, its score and
its place on today's list: today's list first, then by score, then the newest. Costs one credit (the balance
comes back); the same search the same day is paid once. A row's `item_id` asks `why`, and with its title goes
into a draft's examples for save_interest.

query.description: Names, OR between them (at most 5): whole words, `*` any letters after three of the name's own.

name: search
title: Search the news
